entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey Mona, how far in are we now?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The distortion was exceptionally strong in[n]that golden area... We must be drawing[n]close.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But we cannot afford to let our guards[n]down.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even that feeling of closeness may be[n]part of Madarame's deception. We are[n]in his world, after all.
